explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Moscow plague riot of 1771" (revision 1379200176) says: "The Plague Riot (Russian: Чумной бунт, romanized: Chumnoy bunt) was a riot in Moscow in 1771 between 15 and 17 September, caused by an outbreak of bubonic plague." The edge reads that sentence as: 1770–1772 Russian plague caused Moscow plague riot of 1771, and nothing more.
